statement: Fix constants p0, p1 ≥ 0 and m0 > p1. Choose an integer k and a finite dimension n ≥ 2 so that 0.99k > p0 + p1 + 1, k−1 X r=1 rn−1 (n − 1)! < 0.01. (3.9) Let (ζj, hj) be a sequence of pairs from a countable dense subset of an open disk in C and the nonnegative integers, with every pair repeated infinitely often. At stage j, choose numbers Rj ≥ 1, cj ≥ 1, an integer Nj > hj, and a grid from Lemma 3.1 sufficiently large and accurate for Lemma 3.2 at order hj. Set Sj = Rjecj/Nj , log Nj ≤ cj/100. Choose heights Dj and positive numbers αj such that α−1 j ≤ ep1cj , and, along the repetitions of every fixed pair, cj −→ ∞, Dj −→ ∞, Dj cj −→ 0. (3.10) There are phases bj,ξ, one per good projective direction and constant throughout its cycle of lifts, with the following property. Let ℓ be a smooth real function on Cn × C, and let T = {(s, y, w) : Im w > ℓ(s, y)}. Suppose every stage satisfies these conditions: 1. On |s| ≤ Sj, ℓ(s, ζj) ≤ Dj − 2. (3.11) 2. For every holomorphic f on T with |f| ≤ 1, every w with Im w = Dj, and every |s| = Sj, |fy(s, ζj, w)| ≤ ep0cj . (3.12) 3. For every good direction ξ, every lift v = e2πiq/Nj vξ, and every w on that height line, the holomorphic disk t 7−→ Rjv, ζj + t, w + iαjbj,ξt  , |t| < em0cj , (3.13) is contained in T . Then every bounded holomorphic function on T is constant. The phases depend only on the grids and their assigned jet orders, not on ℓ, f, or w.
